ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white/cream pixels dominate approximately 75% of the visible surface, contrasted against a central vertical low-intensity black band and dark trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large central vertical black band extending from the peduncle; yellowish-tan/ochre contiguous mottling clustered at the medial transition zones of both lobes; black pigmentation at distal tips; sparse black micro-speckling distributed across the white planar surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch visible at the center with a projected 2D angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile; numerous jagged peaks and valleys (amplitude estimated 5-15 pixels) distributed continuously along the trailing boundary from the median notch to both distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve across the mid-span of the lobes transitioning to a concave taper as the edge approaches the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Scattered high-contrast black circular pixel clusters (speckling) observed primarily on the inner white regions of both lobes, more concentrated on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, horizontally-oriented grey linear disruptions detected on the mid-section of the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular micro-notching and physical wear along the entire perimeter of the trailing edge; significant yellowish-brown staining near the peduncle-lobe interface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct ochre-colored pigmentation pattern framing the central black region, contrasting sharply with the primary white lobe surface.
